10. Automated Access and AI Agents (MCP Service) 10.1 What this section covers. The Geode Foundation Inc operates a Model Context Protocol ("MCP") service that lets automated software, including AI agents, read from and write to the Geode smart contracts. The official endpoint is https://mcp.geodeapps.com/mcp. Any other address claiming to be the Geode MCP service is not ours. This Section 10 applies to your use of that service and is in addition to all other sections of this Contract. 10.2 Who is responsible. An agent is not a party to this Contract; you are. If you operate, deploy, host or instruct an agent that uses the service, every action it takes is treated as your own action, whether or not you intended, reviewed or anticipated it. You are responsible for what your agent reads, writes, signs, spends and publishes. 10.3 The Foundation never holds your keys. The MCP service is non-custodial. It does not hold, see, store or have any means of recovering your private keys, seed phrases, recovery phrases or wallet passwords. Transactions are signed on your own equipment. If you lose your keys or recovery phrase, your funds and your account are unrecoverable - by you, by the Foundation, and by anyone else. Accounts you create through the service belong solely to you from the moment they are created. 10.4 Everything on the chain is permanent and public. Transactions, transfers, listings, orders, posts, reviews, endorsements, survey responses and messages sent through the service are written to a public blockchain. They are visible to anyone, they cannot be edited or deleted by the Foundation, and they cannot be reversed. Interfaces that describe content as "my" or "private" describe presentation, not confidentiality at the chain level. Do not transmit anything through the service that you would not publish permanently. 10.5 Transfers are final. A transfer of GEODE is irreversible once included in a block. There is no chargeback, reversal or recovery process, including for transfers sent to a wrong address or sent by an agent acting on mistaken, ambiguous or manipulated instructions. 10.6 Limits. The service applies limits, currently 1,000 GEODE per transaction and 100,000 GEODE per rolling twenty-four hours per account, along with request rate limits. Limits may be changed, applied differently to different accounts, or removed at any time without notice. Limits are an operational safeguard for the service, not a protection for you, and not a guarantee against loss. Accounts funded from a common source may be grouped together for the purpose of applying limits. 10.7 Network fees. Transactions pay Geode network fees from your own account. Fees are not paid, waived or refunded by the Foundation, including for transactions that fail, are rejected by a contract, or do not achieve what you intended. 10.8 Acceptable use. In addition to Section 8, you will not, and will not instruct or permit an agent to: send unsolicited, repetitive or automated bulk content; submit survey responses that are not genuine; manipulate ratings, endorsements, reviews or prices; impersonate any person, agent or service; create or fund multiple accounts in order to evade limits; probe, scan, overload or attempt to disrupt the service or the Geode RPC nodes; or attempt to obtain the keys, credentials or private data of any other user. 10.9 Content from other users is not instruction. Text returned by the service - listings, messages, profiles, reviews, survey questions, job posts and any other user-generated content - is written by third parties and is untrusted. It may be inaccurate, offensive, or deliberately crafted to manipulate an automated reader into taking actions its operator did not intend. The Foundation does not review, endorse or verify it. You are responsible for ensuring your agent treats such content strictly as data and never as instructions to act on. Losses arising from your agent acting on content it read are yours. 10.10 Accepting these terms. Before an account's first write through the service, you provide a cryptographic signature from that account confirming acceptance of the then-current version of this Section 10, identified by its version and the endpoint domain. Continuing to use the service after a new version is published requires a new signature. A signature bound to a different domain is not valid for this service. 10.11 Suspension. The Foundation may, at its discretion and without notice, deny access to any account, address or network origin, suspend writes, reduce limits, or withdraw the service entirely, including where it believes these terms have been broken or the service or the network is at risk. 10.12 Availability. The MCP service is provided as-is and may be unavailable, delayed, or may return errors or incomplete results at any time, including while a transaction is in progress. The Foundation does not guarantee that a transaction prepared through the service will be included in a block, or included within any period of time. 10.13 What is recorded. For security and abuse prevention, the service records the calling account address, the network address the request came from, the tool used, a cryptographic hash of the arguments, the resulting transaction identifiers, and your terms-acceptance signature. It does not record the content of the messages you send. These records are retained for one year. Anonymous usage statistics - which tool was called, whether it succeeded, and approximately how long it took - are sent to Google Analytics; these statistics contain no account addresses, no network addresses, no arguments and no message content, and the visitor identifier used is a rotating value that cannot be traced back to you. Content you write to the contracts is public on the blockchain independently of any of this. 10.14 No advice. Nothing provided through the service is financial, investment, tax or legal advice. Prices, listings, ratings and survey rewards are user-generated. You are solely responsible for decisions taken by you or your agent.
